summary: Iteration 3 retest of the HIGH auth-reload race. FIXED and verified on web at 375x667. Priya: reloading /order/DEMO0001 twice keeps her signed in, and TAX INVOICE LE/DEMO/000001 is shown. Network: /auth/me 200, then /orders/DEMO0001 200, with no token-less request. Reloading /orders twice lists DEMO0005/0003/0001, not empty. Ravi: reloading home twice keeps him signed in, with open job DEMO0004 and Accept visible. A forced 500 on /api/orders shows 'Couldn't load orders - Pull down to try again.' and does not log the user out. A cold deep link while signed out redirects to /login. Checkout page prefill is JSON-escaped and includes contact +919845012345. Regression passed: login, booking (locations, items, review with 3-Wheeler quote and Confirm button), and logout to /login. Backend pytest: 59/59 pass. No deprecated Expo packages and no SafeAreaView issues detected.

issues: The retry hint is 'Pull down to try again', but pull-to-refresh does not work on web, and the empty and error states share testID orders-empty-state. Consider adding a Retry button (testID orders-retry-button) and a separate testID such as orders-error-state.
After opening /order/DEMO0001 while signed out and then logging in, the user lands on '/' instead of the order they opened (the return path is not kept). Low priority UX.

action_items: LOW: Orders error state: add a tappable Retry button that calls refetch(), because pull-to-refresh is unavailable on web, and give the error view its own testID.
LOW (optional): Keep the deep-link target through login and redirect to it after auth.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts: capturing 'sent' and clearing the token only when sent === token is correct. A 401 on a request sent without a token no longer wipes the session.
_layout.tsx: the Stack renders only when loading is false, so screens cannot fetch before the token loads. Verified via the network log.
seed_data_creation: None. Side effect: calling POST /api/payments/create for DEMO0005 (to test the checkout page) updated DEMO0005.razorpay_order_id to a new test Razorpay order, order_TxGwpSQjo3Clvy. Its status is still pending_payment. No orders or bookings were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The auth reload race is fixed. Stepper testIDs follow the pattern item-{key}-plus/-minus/-value. book-items and book-review are ScreenHeader testIDs, so check page.url or the inner testIDs instead. Do not delete DEMO* orders or @demo.luggease.in users.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 2 root cause: Expo Router mounted the deep-linked screens before AuthProvider's loadToken() finished. Their queries were sent with no token, and the old api.ts cleared the token on any 401. Mitigation (verified): gate the Stack on the loading state, and clear the token only when the token that was sent is the one rejected.
